manualEntry.rows: 1-100. Resolve exact active product identity and current outbound/estimate units. Convert actual box/bunch/stem quantities from operator-confirmed packing. Unknown optional physical quantities remain null.
manualEntry.amount: Explicit total or per-stem price in the supplied document currency. Zero is valid and blanks are rejected. Store UPrice per stem and TPrice as the stem total.
manualEntry.confirmation: Preview exact normalized payload; scope or field edits invalidate confirmation. Revalidate inside locked transaction; repeat same UUID and normalized values return one existing receipt. Same invoice scope or linked document blocks new registration.
manualEntry.preservation: Existing packing-file upload, order/shipment, invoice document/revisions, estimates and profit ledger are preserved.
